itinerary.title: Arrival SGN - Transfer to Dalat
activities: Suggested arrival time: 12pm or earlier
Arrive Tan Son Nhat International Airport (SGN) HCM
Land transfer to Da Lat (6-8 Hours drive)
Check In Hotel Dalat

itinerary.title: Dalat Fullday Tour
activities: Mongo Land (Rainbow Slide Included)
Flower Park (Largest flower park in Dalat)
Mei Linh Coffee Garden (Fresh coffee plantation taste)
Shopping Amee Wholesale (Fashion designer market)
Datanla Waterfall (Roller coaster included)
Railway Station (Experience the thrill train path)
Return Hotel, Free & Easy

itinerary.title: Muine Fullday Tour
activities: Land transfer to Mui Nee (5 Hours drive)
White Sand Dunes (The only desert in Southeast Asia)
Red Sand Dunes (JEEP & ATV Activity @ Sand Dunes optional)
Fishing Village (Pristine beaches, vibrant fishing boats, and bustling markets)
Land transfer to HCM (3 Hours drive)
Stop by Gudang Shopping Telekung, Tudung etc.
Check in Hotel HCM.
Free & Easy - Shopping at Malaysia Street & Ben Thanh Market

itinerary.title: Mekong River Fullday Tour
activities: Mekong Tour: Tien (Mekong) River Delta’s Dragon, Unicorn, Tortoise and Phoenix Islands
Honey Bee-farm (Taste delicious honey tea with lemon)
Coconut candy workshop (Witness and try to do it)
Ride on Horse-cart
Soai Kinh Lam Fabric Market (The largest fabric market)
Free & Easy – Street night market

itinerary.title: HCM - Return KL
activities: Suggested departure time: 3pm & before
Free & Easy - Shopping Ben Thanh Market
Transfer to Tan Son Nhat International Airport (SGN)

expect.title: Attraction Places
expect.body: Attraction places may require a long journey to reach, 3 to 8 hours on some days.

expect.title: Full Board Meals
expect.body: Meals are already included in the package. If you choose not to consume them, no refund will be provided.

expect.title: Lots of Walking
expect.body: Some attractions require a lot of walking.

expect.title: Hotel Locations
expect.body: Hotels near the city centre are prioritised first. If not available, the hotel will be just outside the city centre.

expect.title: Luggage Allocation
expect.body: Please bring a maximum of 1 luggage per pax, as it affects car capacity.

entries: All prices are valid for 24 hours after quotation submission.
The price is for 2 to 3 persons per room.
Late booking surcharge of RM50/booking will be charged if the booking is made less than 45 days before departure.
Last minute surcharge will be charged if the booking is made less than 3 weeks before departure (refer to the Last Minute Surcharges table).
All itinerary, flight, price or quotation is subject to change.
The itinerary during the trip is subject to change due to weather, traffic, safety and similar factors.
Final itinerary and hotel arrangements 14 days before the trip.
Please check with our staff on the trip validity before booking any connecting flights.
Any free activity is non-exchangeable for other activities, vouchers or cash if the client does not join, or due to availability and weather conditions.
